title: TAA Rewrite
body:

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/67332
- Partially Resolves https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/69492 (No effect on FSR)
- Resolves TAA edge problems (expanding and contracting depending on motion)
- Resolves instances of Dark Ringing around bright objects in motion ~(caused by catmull-rom history sampling)~
- Probably Resolves https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/81709
- Partially resolves https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/69493 (There is still a little blur, but significantly better, Noisier Scrolling Textures will likely remain problematic)

## Additional information

The TAA has been rewritten to use the History as a guide with which Resolve decides which of the 17 samples around the current pixel (based on MSAA sampling pattern) from the current frame are the closest match to the History, and thus should be most stable and least aliased.

As the Resolve is using Exclusively data in the current frame, around the current pixel using Bilinear sampling, the Ghosting and Jitter get limited exclusively to areas that are Heavily Under Sampled and the pixel's Bilinear Neighbourhood is very noisy.
I am experimenting a Little more with methods to further try and improve the History Guidance to further improve results, but I'm not sure how much further I'll be able to push quality.

The Technique also works Fantastic in combination MSAA

No AI was used at any point of developing these changes.

## Questions

I'm unsure if the Comment stating that TAA is based on Spartan Engine's TAA should be kept or not given the massive change in Approach. Right now I've opted to remove it.
